rules.name: Active Directory Domain Enumeration
rules.description: Detect AD enumeration via LDAP queries, DSQuery, BloodHound collection
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where (RequestUri_s in ("/admin", "/phpinfo", "/.env", "/.git", "/wp-admin") and httpStatusCode_d in (403, 404)) | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), clientIp_s | where count_ > 5
